newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish WKSM quarrier allots shares at PLN 44.1.
newsitem.headline: Polish WKSM quarrier allots shares at PLN 44.1.

text.p: The Polish treasury ministry allotted shares in the privatisation offer of granite and gravel quarrier Wroclawskie Kopalnie Surowcow Mineralnych SA (WKSM) at 44.1 zlotys, the deputy treasury minister said.
Piotr Czyzewski told PAP news agency that investors bid for 778,980 shares in the offer of 132,950 shares at a minimum price of 26 zlotys.
PAP said investors who bid with a limit higher than 44.1 zlotys received all their desired shares while those who bid with a 44.1-zloty limit had orders reduced by 50.8 percent.
The firm is offering another 80,600 new shares to employees at the static price of 26 zlotys.
WKSM, which seeks a parallel market listing, had 403,000 shares before the issue.
The largest shareholders were the state treasury with 53 percent and Bank Zachodni with 35.5 percent.
